firstOccurrence.englishText: When the people had come to the forest, behold, honey was dripping, but no one put his hand to his mouth; for the people feared the oath.

timeline.evidenceText: When the people had come to the forest, behold, honey was dripping, but no one put his hand to his mouth; for the people feared the oath.

A traveler came to the rich man, and he spared to take of his own flock and of his own herd, to prepare for the wayfaring man who had come to him, but took the poor man’s lamb, and prepared it for the man who had come to him.”
